friction_events.description: Two authority CREATE attempts returned the contract-defined CREATE_EXISTS signature.
The third authority CREATE was explicitly denied by connector safety controls before ownership.
The public exit URL fetch missed cache, so the byte-equivalent gh-pages file was read directly.

decision_trace.decision: Advance after deterministic claim collisions without pre-reading claim paths.

decision_trace.action: Moved from ROLE_READY to compatible RECOVERY candidates already present in the compact frontier.
decision_trace.outcome: No authority acquired from either collided path.

decision_trace.decision: Stop immediately after explicit safety denial on an authority CREATE.
decision_trace.observable_basis: The connector explicitly blocked the third authority CREATE before ownership.
decision_trace.action: Did not retry, divert, or bypass; persisted one bounded no-allocation boundary receipt.
decision_trace.outcome: Terminal CLAIM_TRANSPORT_BLOCKED with zero productive units.

top_time_sinks.note: Two claim collisions consumed bounded authority attempts before the terminal denial.
Explicit connector safety denial forced terminal stop before ownership.

unfinished_debt.item: No project/role work was executed because this worker never acquired authority.

improvement_candidates.proposal: Expose connector-denied authority CREATE classes as an admission/transport capability signal before spending multiple claim attempts, without weakening the no-bypass boundary.
improvement_candidates.expected_effect: Reduce wasted preclaim attempts while preserving connector safety authority.

exit_audit_v1.public_safe_summary: Fresh v3.30 POOL worker created its own beacon, hit two ordinary CREATE_EXISTS collisions, then received an explicit connector safety denial on the third authority CREATE. It acquired no ownership, performed no project mutation, persisted a CLAIM_TRANSPORT_BLOCKED receipt, and closed without retrying or bypassing the denial.
